blend: ALPHA blend assumed (soft foam over water); additive-safe too: RGB is bright wherever alpha > 0 and zeroed wherever alpha == 0, so both alpha-multiplied additive (SRC_ALPHA, ONE) and raw ADD (ONE, ONE) only brighten. VERIFY in UPBGE which blend mode the material uses.
